name: @avatark/living-population-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral, franchise-neutral contracts for the Sprint 10 living-population/behavior domain: needs, daily rhythms, bounded semantic perception, deterministic behavior/movement intent, herd/flock group state, encounter opportunities, and a population snapshot. No implementations, no renderer objects, zero franchise content.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
